<tspan x="823.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="823.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="823.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="823.0" y="2215" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="823.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="823.0" y="2245" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="823.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="823.0" y="2270" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="823.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: Two edge types own distinct in_i and out_i Linear modules; all time steps reuse these same four modules and the same Propogator gates.
Adjacency packs incoming and outgoing typed blocks. Separate BMMs form messages; source concatenates both messages and current state for two gates.
Reset r acts on current state before candidate formation. Update formula is (1-z)*state_cur+z*h_hat, preserving the source gate convention.
Class is misspelled Propogator and candidate member tansform in source; identities preserve those spellings.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
